column1: # The iteration order of Agrona 2.6.1's Long2LongHashMap, read off the jar, not
# off the bytecode. The consensus module's timer snapshot writes its records in
# exactly this order (WheelTimerService.snapshot iterates this map), so a
# reimplementation that merely stores the right pairs still produces different
# Cases: sequential keys with no resize, sequential keys past several resizes,
# scattered keys, removals (which run compactChain), and remove-then-reinsert.
#   javac -cp agrona-2.6.1.jar Gen.java && java -cp agrona-2.6.1.jar:. Gen
